weakest_scene.root_cause: The scene draws two period values as a size comparison or difference, when the claim is a count: 1440 / 93 ≈ 16 sunrises in one day.

Have the ISS lap it and flash a sunrise at each 93-minute tick, so 16 suns pile up and a counter reaches 16, next to a single sunrise for someone on the ground. Data can count them off or duck each flash. Drop the '1,347 apart' ending.
